title: Metapath-guided topology and domain knowledge fusion for predicting miRNA-drug-disease triplet resistance and sensitivity associations.
snippet: Accurately predicting drug resistance and sensitivity is critical for understanding disease treatment mechanisms and improving therapeutic strategies. MicroRNAs (miRNAs) play essential roles in regulating drug response.
